# iximiuz-labs_me (Data Source)

Retrieves information about the current authenticated iximiuz Labs user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iximiuz-labs_me" "current" {}

output "user_id" {
  value = data.iximiuz-labs_me.current.id
}

output "has_premium" {
  value = data.iximiuz-labs_me.current.has_premium
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `github_profile_id` (String) The user's GitHub profile ID.
- `has_premium` (Boolean) Whether the user has an active premium subscription.
- `id` (String) The unique user ID.
- `premium_lifetime` (Boolean) Whether the user has a lifetime premium subscription.
- `premium_trial` (Boolean) Whether the user is on a premium trial.
- `premium_until` (String) ISO timestamp of when the premium subscription expires.
